result.summary: The page is generally intact, but there is one clearly broken data display: a restaurant card renders an invalid delivery price as “€NaN”. Excluded carousel edge clipping and bottom viewport cutoff are not reported.

issues.description: The “Smash Bros Burgers” card shows “€NaN delivery”, indicating the delivery fee failed to load or was not formatted before rendering.
issues.suggestion: Guard against null/undefined delivery fees, format valid values as currency, and show a safe fallback such as “Free delivery”, “Delivery unavailable”, or hide the fee until data loads.
